svg.text: Open Duck Mini v2 + MaixCAM2: full wiring
Every part on the BOM. Pin table: docs/WIRING.md. Power details: docs/POWER.md.
20 hip yaw > 21 hip roll > 22 hip pitch > 23 knee > 24 ankle
10 hip yaw > 11 hip roll > 12 hip pitch > 13 knee > 14 ankle
30 neck pitch > 31 head pitch > 32 head yaw > 33 head roll
3-wire bus cable (7.4 V, GND, data), daisy-chained. 14 servos,
IDs as in odm_maix/hwi.py. Never feed the servos through the buck.
pins: right header top, left header left
foot COM to MaixCAM2 GND (left header)
50 Hz PWM, 3.3 V signal is fine
L on B3, R on A30, 330 Ω to anode
cathode to GND; none with screen_face
Optional: servo bus on UART4 instead of USB
A21 UART4_TX > servo board RX, A22 UART4_RX < TX, GND
/dev/ttyS4, check the board's UART is 3.3 V
All MaixCAM2 IO is 3.3 V. One common ground. Do not use A28/A29 (console); A2 is blocked. Dashed boxes are optional or depend on the head layout.
Generated by tools/wiring/make_wiring_svg.py. Edit that script, not this file.
